verdict.rationale: Asana's own marketing says users can turn team expertise into custom AI Teammates. Each agent gets an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail and cost constraints managed from an admin console, and the API can list configured AI Teammates. That establishes a first-party custom-agent capability, but the evidence shows only governance-level configuration. There is no hands-on walkthrough of actually building an agent. missing for 10: documented step-by-step agent builder (instructions, tools, triggers), configuration depth beyond governance controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Turn your team's collective expertise into custom AI Teammates built to handle the complex, coordination-heavy work that slows your team down.
Every agent has an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints, with data access, approved actions, and spend all managed from the same console that governs human users.
Returns the compact records of agents (AI Teammates) configured.
